questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if USCO and ITM are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Do you consider there are differences between the undercarriage systems and components for tracked machinery used in different industries, e.g. construction, mining, forestry and agriculture?

Do you consider OEM-branded replacement parts for undercarriage components and independent aftermarket replacement parts for undercarriage components to be substitutes (i.e. can they be used for the same applications)?

How many suppliers of undercarriage components for heavy tracked machinery do you consider there are in Australia? Please identify key suppliers and where they supply (i.e. nationally, or in a particular region).
If you are a customer of undercarriage components for heavy tracked machinery, describe any barriers there are to switching suppliers for those components.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with USCO and/or ITM.
